name: CodeRabbit (GitHub Enterprise Server)

install_scope.notes: Install on each organization CodeRabbit should review.

manual_steps: Also create the OAuth App described in CodeRabbit's docs; CodeRabbit needs both.
Set a webhook secret, generate a client secret and a private key, and enter them with the app ID and client ID in CodeRabbit's onboarding form.
Install the app only after completing CodeRabbit's setup, or redeliver the failed installation event from the app's Advanced tab.
notes: CodeRabbit's docs set the app to be installable on any account (public). Checks write is for the CodeRabbit Security check.
